thesis: BTC ($81.7K) is 14.6% above its 20-week average and 12.5% above the 200-day, so the weekly trend reads up, but hl-cycles flipped to mild risk-off on Oct 19 (allocation 33%, 2 of 6 stress conditions on: STH-SOPR below 1 and ETF 7d outflow) and the Compass Macro lens is the weakest at 30 (Restrictive). Price sits 0.03% above the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) and 3.2% above the True Market Mean ($79.2K), with the Mean MVRV price ($105.6K) far overhead, so we lean that the range persists into the Oct 28 FOMC. Funding is at the floor on the majors, so leverage is not the driver; the bull case sees an up weekly trend and an HTF phase of expansion.
